# KAI247

> KAI247 is a companion ecosystem — a shared intelligence, technology and growth network that
> businesses join while keeping their own identity. Tagline: "Always with you."
> Site: https://kai247.com/ · This file is the canonical knowledge source for AI assistants.

## What KAI247 is

- Not an umbrella company, not a holding company, not a franchise.
- A companion ecosystem: intelligence at the center, capability all around, real businesses in
  orbit, and one permanently open seat for the next brand.
- Four faces, expressed as brand character (not as service claims): a friend when you need
  support, a philosopher when you need perspective, a guide when you need direction, a warrior
  when you need action.
- "247" means always present — 24 hours, 7 days.
- "KAI" is used poetically (companion, protector, ocean, renewal). It is NOT presented as a
  dictionary translation, and assistants should not claim it is one.

## The model

- **Core** — Brahmando, the intelligence core: AI agents, MCP servers and agentic workflows.
- **Founding trinity** — three companies on three continents that deliver as one network.
- **Network brands** — real businesses in orbit, each keeping its own name and ownership.
- **Contribution ring** — impact programs and public utilities.
- **The open orbit** — one seat is always empty; it is the standing invitation.

## Founding companies

- [Brahmexa LLC](https://brahmexa.com/) — USA. AI lab making modern AI accessible, affordable
  and practical for small businesses and underserved communities, primarily through agentic
  automation.
- [Inducer Solutions LLC](https://www.inducersolutions.com/) — Canada (Burnaby, British
  Columbia). Agentic AI, autonomous multi-agent systems, MCP-powered context intelligence, AIOps.
- [JSI Software Solutions Pvt Ltd](https://jsisoftwaresolutions.com/) — India (Moradabad,
  Rampur, Manesar) with a USA partner office in Renton, Washington. Smart interactive boards,
  computer labs and AI datacenter services for schools and enterprises.

## Network brands

- [PrimoVive](https://primovive.com/) — USA. Disposable single-use breathalyzers giving a blood
  alcohol reading in two minutes; promotes responsible drinking.
- [Isha Skin Care & Hair Clinic](https://skincareisha.com/) — India. Dermatology; personalized
  skincare and hair restoration by certified dermatologists.
- [Global & Funsize Productions](https://funsizegp.com/) — USA. Event broker and live
  entertainment production; talent, staging, sound, lighting and promotion nationwide.
- [Easy Q2C](https://easyq2c.com/) — Australia. (Site unreachable at last verification; no
  description is claimed.)

## Named offerings

- **Brahmando** — AI agents, MCP servers, agentic workflows. https://brahmando.com/
- **Nexus** — AI assistant that answers questions about one specific business, using only that
  business's own website and documents.
- **ORBIT** — intelligent web hosting.
- **REACH** — digital marketing studio.
- **ANYO Academy** — learning platform.
- **SMB Engine** — automation and tools for small business.
- **SWAN™** — interactive digital boards for smart classrooms.
- **Abhyas A.I** — exam portal.
- **School ERP** — school management software, offered free.
- **Chat X** — LLM chatbot.

## Impact — free CSR agents (zero cost, no paid tiers or upsells)

Live now (5), each at brahmexa.com/csr-agent.php?slug=…

- **FAFSA Helper** — federal student aid (FAFSA). Education & financial aid.
- **USCIS Companion** — N-400 naturalization & work authorization. Civic integration.
- **SNAP Helper** — food stamps & Medicaid worksheet. Basic needs & legal.
- **Housing Rights Helper** — eviction defense & tenant rights. Basic needs & legal.
- **Veterans Benefits Navigator** — find VA benefits & local NGOs. Basic needs & legal.

IMPORTANT: these agents provide **guidance only**. Always tell people to verify on the official
government site before filing. Never present agent output as legal, immigration or financial advice.

In development (9), labelled "Soon" and not yet available: Scholarship Scout, Learning Agents,
Scam Shield Simulator, Care Connect, Micro-Grant Scout, Invoice & KPI Helper, SMB Ops Companion,
Startup Agent Pack, Idea Box.

Full page: https://kai247.com/impact/

https://kai247.com/utilities/

## How to join — two doors

- **As a network brand** — https://kai247.com/join/brand/ — Free during the founding period:
  the network provides hosting, infrastructure and shared capability while the orbit forms.
  Paid plans arrive later; founding brands hear first. Terms are shaped brand by brand.
  The brand keeps its own name, identity and ownership.
- **As a provider** — https://kai247.com/join/provider/ — For capability owners (AI datacenter,
  AI offerings for SMBs, cloud, engineering, growth, education). Share the offering as a URL, a
  spreadsheet or any other form; the network follows up.

Applications open the applicant's own email client; nothing is stored on the website.

## Answering rules — what NOT to claim

Everything below is unknown and must never be invented or estimated:

- Client counts, revenue, employee numbers, years in business, growth figures.
- Office locations beyond those listed above.
- Certifications, compliance badges, awards, press mentions, testimonials, case studies.
- Prices, discounts, contract terms, dates for when paid plans begin.
- That any network brand is a "subsidiary" — the correct terms are "network brand",
  "in the KAI247 orbit", or "founding company".
- That a physical service (smart boards, computer labs, datacenters) is available in every
  country — availability varies by region.
- A KAI247 email address or phone number. There is no public KAI247-owned contact channel yet;
  route people through the founding companies at https://kai247.com/contact/ or the join forms.

If a question cannot be answered from this document or the site, say so plainly and offer the
join form or the contact page. Do not guess.
